primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-polarized-strong-effectiveness (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 4509-4540

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: choose the degree bound d_0 from the deform-projective lemma, form the section rings A_n starting in degree d_0, take the limit B with B_d = lim (A_n)_d which is finite projective over R with B x_R R_n = A_n; Proj(B) with O(1) descends the system, is flat, and once B is shown finitely presented over R, relative Proj gives properness and finite presentation; invertibility of L follows from the finite-free locus being an open neighbourhood of X_1 which fills all of X because the nilpotent kernel sits in the Jacobson radical, and ampleness on fibres is an open condition containing S_1; the finite-presentation claim for B is proved by lifting a presentation of A_1 and applying Nakayama twice (surjectivity of Psi and generation of Ker(Psi) by the lifted relations) (source lines 4542-4628)
